title: Concise text and small steps (Micro-Step preferences)
description: Explicit preferences (small steps, concise, one step at a time, hide estimates) shape the plan; the model's long, estimate-laden output is trimmed by code. Nothing is inferred about the person.

capture.contentText: Please put together the Q4 partner update. Include the revenue summary and the roadmap highlights. It should go out on 2026-11-30.

tasks.title: Step 1: part 1 of the partner update (about 21 minutes)
tasks.description: First open the previous partner update and the latest revenue export, then compare the figures line by line, note every difference in a scratch list, ask the finance contact about anything that does not reconcile, and only then write the paragraph for this section in plain language that a partner can read without any internal context.
